responsibility: This file implements construction and assembly emission of the eBPF .BTF.ext section used for BPF CO-RE and related extended BTF metadata. It owns the in-memory collection of per-section func_info, line_info, and CO-RE relocation records, validates and sizes those records, assigns string-table offsets and labels, and writes the final BTF.ext header and section payloads to assembly output so loaders can later patch structure, type, and enum references against target-kernel BTF data.
same_name_distinction: Implements the runtime side of the btfext-out pair: it owns the mutable .BTF.ext state and emits the assembled section contents to asm output, including headers, per-section func_info/core_relo records, sizing, validation, and labels, whereas btfext-out.h only publishes the on-disk record layouts, enums, and callable entry points for other BPF backend files.
